free_tier.stated: No free tier. Two paid plans, Lite and Pro. Lite allows about 1,200 requests per 5 hours, 9,000/week and 18,000/month; Pro about 6,000 per 5 hours, 45,000/week and 90,000/month. Prices render dynamically and are not stated on the page.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: a subscription meters usage, not objects

retention.stated: not applicable: the vendor serves the inference; no caller-stored bytes

egress.terms: not applicable: the vendor serves the inference

tooling: OpenAI-compatible /api/coding/v3 and Anthropic-compatible /api/coding; Claude Code, OpenCode, Cursor, Cline and OpenClaw are named
chaining: the monthly/5-hour request quota is the scarce link; plan keys work only in approved AI coding tools, not as a general API

limits.value: about 1,200 to 6,000 requests per 5 hours by tier
out-of-scope API use can suspend the subscription or ban the account

identity_cost.detail: a Volcengine Ark account and a purchased plan; real-name verification for Chinese cloud accounts is common but not stated on this page

reliability_note: the model catalogue changes dynamically and several models are flagged as going offline; out-of-scope API use risks suspension

evidence.proved: the Coding Plan is a paid subscription service with no free tier
Lite allows about 1,200 requests per 5 hours

notes: Paid-only. The doc URL is a get-started page; the plan-overview and usage-limit pages supply the offer and quota. Prices render dynamically as '价格查询中' and are left unverified rather than invented.
